name: localmod
description: Local-first desktop studio for open-weight models — React + Electron for Mac & Windows
author: Localmod

scripts.desktop: concurrently -k -n engine,ui,electron -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev:engine" "npm run dev:ui" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:4781/health http://127.0.0.1:1420 && cross-env LOCALMOD_EXTERNAL_ENGINE=1 electron apps/desktop/electron/main.cjs"
scripts.prepare:app: node scripts/pack-engine.mjs && node scripts/pack-suite.mjs && npm run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --publish never && node scripts/pack-windows-apps.mjs
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
scripts.build:linux: npm run prepare:app && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --linux --publish never
